question: Can one currently visible ordinary Soldier-only own force be recorded before intent and observed through a friendly no-line terminal merge, optionally preceded by one unarmed empty-neutral preparation capture?

allowed_gestures: optional one ordinary Soldier-only own-source drag to a positively visible empty neutral neighbor, observer remains disarmed
one ordinary Soldier-only own-source drag to a positively visible own neighbor, observer arms exactly once before this drag

preview.host_policy: Connect-only. Requires an already-running project-owned official headless host with at least 30 seconds remaining. The preview itself never starts a host or arms the observer.
reads: one ready canonical ClientExtractor snapshot with PLAYER_VISIBLE_COMPLETE current visible-set coverage
visible own and neutral tower facts, typed units/deployables, cached morale effect Tower+45, capacity, potential production, adjacency, relation, delay and own-only supply-line presence
current full visible force set, including any inbound forces that would make a destination contested
explicit normal selected_tower None, canvas geometry, projected endpoint centers and read-only elementFromPoint hit tests
bounded page metadata: official origin/path, title, ready/visibility/focus, canvas geometry, visual viewport and visible h1/h2 headings
candidate_rules: Source must be positively visible SELF/owned, delay zero, cached Tower+45 observed false, own supply-line observed false, no Ruler, and exactly Soldier-only current deployable inventory.

Friendly destination must be positively visible SELF/owned, supply-line observed false, no Ruler, cached Tower+45 known, capacity known, Shield count not above Shield capacity, and no visible inbound force.

Neutral preparation destination must be positively visible owner 0 and completely empty, no Ruler, capacity known, Shield count not above Shield capacity, and no visible inbound force. Its own-only supply-line overlay is not applicable.
Both endpoints must be current adjacent visible towers, project safely within the unchanged canvas, and hit the canvas at their projected centers.
preview.route_and_input_scope: Candidate adjacency is not a handler-consumption or path certificate. Route/terminal lineage and gesture continuity remain UNKNOWN until independent callback-binding and release review.
preview.output: All candidate pairs and their exact before facts are retained; no pair is auto-selected. Guard refusals, lease margin and any extraction error are written to a new exclusive JSON receipt. Zero formal and trajectory credit.

operator_sequence_for_later_root_run.actions: Run only the connect-only preview script against the already-owned host. Review the saved snapshot, candidate fields, refusals and lease margin; choose explicit source/destination IDs manually. Do not treat route output as qualified.

operator_sequence_for_later_root_run.condition: Only if a reviewed Soldier-only source and empty neutral neighbor are in the fresh preview and enough host lease remains.
operator_sequence_for_later_root_run.observer: The observer may have been registered at host startup, but this preparation recorder invocation omits --input-entry-observer and therefore does not arm it.
operator_sequence_for_later_root_run.failure_policy: Any rejection or partial gesture ends the cohort; no replacement or retry command. Preserve the recorder receipt.

operator_sequence_for_later_root_run.actions: If preparation was attempted and the host still has margin, rerun the connect-only preview once to obtain current explicit IDs. If no eligible candidate or the lease guard refuses, stop with no friendly drag. Do not reuse stale IDs or facts.

operator_sequence_for_later_root_run.condition: Only after root reviews a fresh friendly pair and confirms recorder lease remaining is at least the selected --seconds value plus the recorder's 15-second cleanup margin.
operator_sequence_for_later_root_run.observer: The input-entry observer must already have been registered before creation of the official page. This invocation arms it once, after durable BEFORE intent and before the trusted drag.
operator_sequence_for_later_root_run.failure_policy: One drag maximum. Do not retry if any guard, endpoint, continuity, or cleanup stage fails; retain all evidence and classify partial release as possibly dispatched.

validation_boundary.capture: Compare from actual fresh recorded before states and preserve every distinct canonical visible-world state and first mismatch.
validation_boundary.route_or_future_fuel: UNKNOWN unless independently established from eligible before facts; do not infer from arrival.
validation_boundary.dynamic_aura: Use actual sampled Tower+45 facts and pinned refresh-phase evidence only; do not assume the flag stays fixed through a long trajectory.

offline_script_review.readiness_clock: synthetic only: monkeypatched now_ms equals fixture received_at_ms / world_sequence_observed_at_ms
offline_script_review.positive_path_variation: synthetic only: one in-memory source MORALE_BOOST OBSERVED Boolean changed from the fixture's actual true to false to reach candidate and projection checks; fixture bytes were not modified
offline_script_review.selection_and_camera: synthetic only: selected_tower None and camera derived from the fixture's recorded projected endpoint points

root_followup_cohort: Separate actual immediate cohort is recorded in docs/V2_M2A_AURA_AND_FRIENDLY_CHECKPOINT.json; this original prepplan did not execute troopgestures
